# Maritime First Aid Classes

Presented by Northwest Response at The Center for Wooden Boats

Approved by OSHA, L&I, and the USCG

![An instructor teaches a student in a first aid class]()

## HSI Basic First Aid-CPR-AED

A 4.5-hour course for all lay responders, taught by professional emergency medical responders. Approved for the Master Mariner License. Two-year certification.

Boating is one of the great pleasures of the Pacific Northwest, but even a minor injury can ruin a trip. There is no 911 at sea and help may be hours away — build or refresh your first aid skills.

Learn to save a life and have fun at The Center for Wooden Boats!

## Basic First Aid Plus+ CPR/AED

An 8-hour advanced course with more depth on trauma, serious bleeding, head, neck and spinal injuries, patient handling, and evacuation. A complement to basic first aid aimed at recreational boaters. Approved by OSHA, L&I, and the USCG; two-year certification. Taught by professional emergency medical responders; approved for the Master Mariner License.
